figurative_meaning_en: Clear but pleasing in speech; sweet-tongued
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মুখ মিঠে, সবাইকে খুশি করে বলে।
মুখমিষ্টি লোকের সঙ্গে কথা বললে মন ভালো হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a sweet mouth; he speaks in a way that pleases everyone.
Talking with sweet-tongued people makes one feel good.
note: Refers to polite and endearing speech patterns common in Bengali social norms
